name: ota_state
role: OTA accept gate; handlers proceed only when value in {2

name: ota_image_size
role: expected whole-image size recorded by startOTA (0x80)

name: ota_image_crc
role: expected whole-image CRC-32 recorded by startOTA

name: ota_running_crc
role: running CRC-32 of received image data

name: ota_config_crc
role: expected config CRC-32 over the first 88 config bytes

name: ota_overwrite_flag
role: activation flag set to 1 by imageOverwriteConfirm (0x92) after whole-image CRC

name: ota_status
role: status code emitted with OTA responses
